INSERT INTO snapshot_days (user_id, snapshot_on, position_count, unpriced_count)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
        ON CONFLICT (user_id, snapshot_on)
        DO UPDATE SET position_count = EXCLUDED.position_count,
                      unpriced_count = EXCLUDED.unpriced_count,
                      computed_at    = now()
